description: Updates the project's currency configuration. Send only the fields you want to change; omitted fields are left unchanged. `currency_iso_code` can only be updated while `currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update` is true.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore company that owns the project. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore project. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/projects. Identifies which project's currency configuration to act on.

schema.description: Currency configuration for a Procore project. Returned after a successful create, update, or delete; all fields reflect the persisted record.

company_id.description: Procore company ID that owns this project. Matches the {company_id} path parameter.

project_id.description: Procore project ID this configuration belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter and is the foreign key to use for all project-scoped multicurrency requests.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the project's currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'). May differ from the company base currency when company-level multicurrency is enabled.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered for this project. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD).
